messages:
Sana (CSM): Heads up 1: Sparrow Labs kickoff in 2pm PT. Quick internal sync here first - need owners for stakeholders, 30d success metrics, and a contingency plan if they ask for a private deploy mid-pilot.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I can own integration and sample-set evals. Will need access to their sample corpus and a sense of expected throughput.

Tara (Tech PM): I'll draft the milestone timeline and capture infra blockers (VPC, KMS, IP allowlist). Confirming they said AWS KMS but not yet firm.

Eli (Onboarding Eng): I'll prep a light demo harness and a runbook for token scope and API limits. Also can prototype routing fallback to a smaller quantized model.

Sana (CSM): Proposed measurable success criteria: 1) demo passes agreed quality checklist on 100 probes, 2) 95p latency < 800ms on dev traffic, 3) two enablement sessions completed, 4) integration smoke tests green on CI. Anyone object?

Ravi - Solutions Eng: Looks good. I'll add a cost estimate against their sample workload to show relative unit-cost.

Tara (Tech PM): Add a gate: customer signs off on data ingress plan before private deploy. Also add rollback doc for routing changes.

Eli (Onboarding Eng): Can we slot a quick pre-call at 1:15pm PT to run through who demos which flows? I can join.

Sana (CSM): @Ravi @Eli please join 1:15. I'll handle stakeholder intros on the customer side.

onboard-bot: JIRA ticket CS-12899 created: Sparrow Labs 1: onboarding kickoff (owner matrix template attached) https://redwood-internal.example/CS-12899

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll post the integration checklist in the JIRA and tag infra for test token.

Tara (Tech PM): Tentative 30d timeline put here: Day 0 kickoff; Day 1-4 keys + test data ingest; Day 5-12 integration + demo; Day 13-20 evals + perf tuning; Day 21-26 enablement docs + sessions; Day 27-30 go/no-go + next steps.

Sana (CSM): Also flagged renewal-risk note: Sparrow is consolidating vendors next quarter. We should capture two quick wins by Day 12 (perf and cost) to influence their roadmap decision. Ravi/Eli please surface metrics.

Eli (Onboarding Eng): I'll run a small perf comparison and send numbers by Day 10.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll provide token-cost delta and an example throughput plan by Day 10.

Sana (CSM): Great. I'll follow up after the 1:15 pre-call with the owner matrix and the JIRA link. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
